title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland — utterances fixture
description: Schema for the demo caption-room utterance fixture derived from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (Project Gutenberg eBook #11, public domain). Describes the ordered, per-speaker spoken dialogue used to simulate live captioning in the demo room; timing (words/second, pauses, interim cadence) is derived at runtime from `demo-room.constants.ts`, not stored here.

source.description: Attribution and provenance information for the source text.

coverage.description: Which portion of the work the utterances are drawn from.

attribution.description: Attribution statement for the source text.

note.description: Additional notes about how the fixture text was extracted or is intended to be used.

speakers.description: Sorted list of distinct speaker ids appearing in `turns`.

loop.description: Whether the demo playback should loop back to the start after the last turn.

turnCount.description: Total number of entries in the turns array.

lineCount.description: Total number of lines across all turns.

turns.description: Ordered list of speaker turns used to drive the demo caption playback. Consecutive same-speaker dialogue, uninterrupted by another speaker, is one turn; each turn's lines are spoken back to back within it.

items.description: One uninterrupted stretch of dialogue from a single speaker.

speaker.description: Id of the speaker for this turn.

lines.description: Spoken lines, in order, with no enclosing quotation marks.
